note: The script asks for the hook text and one name super, then the end card. Every other row is captions only.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: What has fatherhood asked of you?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “What has fatherhood asked of you?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:22 for 3 s, lower left: “Ian Snyder” / Vista Colina Family Shelter
mg.use: Put it on at 00:22 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions, never on them. Type the second line <Vista Colina Family Shelter> under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry). The CASS name is typed in CASS navy until the logo file is added to endcards/cass/. Wording from the client file: cassaz.org.

text.name: CASS
lines: For more information on Vista Colina Family Shelter visit CASSAZ.org

mg.use: After his last line at 01:01. Hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
